target: Three-digit DDC section, with main class and division derived by prefix
schedule: DDC 23 summary used as section vocabulary; explicit catalog schedule edition retained per record. This is not a claim to have consulted the full current WebDewey schedule.
rules: Prefer same original work and edition language. Preserve translator, volume and commentary differences.
Use primary institutional DDC fields; a local call number without a declared scheme stays qualified. MDS, LCC, NDC and accession numbers are not silently treated as DDC.

For modern section diagnostics, Darwin uses 576, supported by OCLC DDC 23 and the BnF DDC 23 facsimile record. Retain the 575 record with schedule edition unknown; do not claim it was proven obsolete.

For Gandhi, select 954 as a provisional project recommendation based on Hindi autobiography records at IIT Gandhinagar and Tezpur. Keep the LBSNAA 320.55 record as a real catalog-policy conflict. No claim that 954 is uniquely correct for the uploaded translation.
A related commentary/translation can support a subject hint but cannot verify the uploaded original edition.
A suggested section does not create human_checked=true, verified_section, capture permission, checked OCR reference or training eligibility.
All eight already-examined works remain development only. No independent test accuracy is computed from these labels.
